records.jp: さすが夏だよね。学校でこんなにたくさん<CR>ひまわりが咲くんだもん
records.en_original: It sure feels like summer. All the sunflowers are starting to bloom.
records.en: It truly is summer.<CR>So many sunflowers bloom here at the school.

records.jp: ……そうですね。<CR>見たところ、健康状態も良好そうです
records.en_original: Yes... And they appear to be healthy as well.
records.en: Yes...<CR>And they appear to be healthy as well.

records.jp: ところで……<CR>どうして「さすが夏」、なんですか？
records.en_original: By the way... What makes it feel like summer?
records.en: By the way...<CR>What makes it feel like summer?

records.jp: えーと……
records.en_original: Um...
records.en: Um...

records.jp: ひまわりって、夏らしい花だなぁって
records.en_original: Sunflowers are just a summery flower, I guess.
records.en: Sunflowers are just a summery flower, I guess.

records.jp: 夏らしい……ですか？
records.en_original: Summery...?
records.en: Summery...?

records.jp: うん。派手な色で、なんか太陽ーって感じで、<CR>ちょっと暑苦しくてさ
records.en_original: Yeah. They're a really bright color, like the sun. Just looking at them almost makes you feel hot.
records.en: Yeah. They're a really bright color, like the sun.<CR>Just looking at them almost makes you feel hot.

records.jp: 星崎さんの比喩は、独特ですね。<CR>それが、星崎さんにとっての夏の印象なんですね
records.en_original: So that's your impression of summer. Your metaphors are quite unique, Ao.
records.en: So that's your impression of summer.<CR>Your metaphors are quite unique, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: えへ。分かってくれて嬉しい！<CR>あ……でも、それだけじゃないんだー
records.en_original: Eheh. I'm glad you understand! Ah...but that's not all.
records.en: Eheh. I'm glad you understand!<CR>Ah...but that's not all.

records.jp: ひまわりって、なんかたくましくてさ、<CR>夏のパワーを感じるっていうか？
records.en_original: Sunflowers are really tough, so they make you feel the power of summer.
records.en: Sunflowers seem so resilient.<CR>It is as though they contain the power of summer.

records.jp: 私には、暑苦しさの方がしっくりします
records.en_original: Feeling hot from looking at them was a more fitting description to me.
records.en: Feeling hot from looking at them was a more fitting description to me.

records.jp: やっぱ、夏に咲く花といえば、<CR>ひまわりって感じだからかなー
records.en_original: I guess it's because sunflowers bloom in the summer?
records.en: I guess it's because<CR>sunflowers bloom in the summer?

records.jp: 近頃は温室栽培などで、季節に関係なく<CR>花屋にあるそうですが
records.en_original: But they're grown in greenhouses these days, so you can find them in flower shops all year round.
records.en: But they're grown in greenhouses these days,<CR>so you can find them in flower shops all year round.

records.jp: 便利になったよねー。じゃなくてー！<CR>自然の中で育って咲いたやつ！
records.en_original: Convenient, right? But that's not the point! I mean the ones that grow and bloom naturally!
records.en: Convenient, right? But that's not the point!<CR>I mean the ones that grow and bloom naturally!

records.jp: そんなの、地元じゃまず見れないわけなんだけど、<CR>ひまわり見ると、夏なんだなーって
records.en_original: I rarely saw them where I grew up, but when I see sunflowers, I know it's summer.
records.en: I almost never saw them where I lived, but whenever I see sunflowers,<CR>I feel that summer has arrived.

records.jp: つまり、季節に紐づいて連想が浮かぶ、<CR>というわけですね
records.en_original: In other words, you associate certain things with certain seasons.
records.en: In other words, you associate certain things<CR>with certain seasons.

records.jp: といっても、ここで夏以外の季節って、<CR>今んとこ遭遇したことないわけだけど
records.en_original: Summer is the only season we've had here, though.
records.en: Summer is the only season we've had here,<CR>though.

records.jp: 夏……<CR>星崎さんは、夏が好きなんですか？
records.en_original: Summer... Do you like the summer, Ao?
records.en: Summer...<CR>Do you like the summer, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: んー。実はあんまり、かな。<CR>なんていっても暑いし、宿題も多いしなぁ……
records.en_original: Honestly, not really. It's hot, and we always have so much homework...
records.en: Honestly, not really.<CR>It's hot, and we always have so much homework...

records.jp: やっぱ、夏休みくらい、ダラダラしたいよなー。<CR>なーんて
records.en_original: I wish I could just relax and do nothing at least for summer break!
records.en: I wish I could just relax and do nothing at least for<CR>summer break!

records.jp: この場所での生活も、決して<CR>のんびりしているとは言えませんね
records.en_original: Life here can hardly be called leisurely either.
records.en: Life here can hardly<CR>be called leisurely either.

records.jp: そーなんだよねー
records.en_original: I know, right...?
records.en: I know, right...?

records.jp: 私はわりと好きかな、夏って。<CR>そりゃ、シャレにならない暑さの日もあるけど……
records.en_original: I guess I kinda do like summer. The heat can be unbearable some days, but...
records.en: I guess I kinda do like summer.<CR>The heat can be unbearable some days, but...

records.jp: なんか、いろんな生き物が<CR>一番生き生きしてる季節だなって気がするんだよね
records.en_original: The summer season is so vibrant and full of life!
records.en: It feels like the season when<CR>all kinds of living things are at their most lively.

records.jp: 生き物が一番生き生きしている季節……
records.en_original: Vibrant and full of life...
records.en: Vibrant and full of life...

records.jp: だからさ、こうやって一緒にのんびり<CR>ひまわり見るのって、いいと思わない？
records.en_original: So it's nice to sit here and relax and look at the sunflowers, don't you think?
records.en: So it's nice to sit here and relax and look at the sunflowers,<CR>don't you think?

records.jp: ひまわりを見ることが……いいこと、ですか？
records.en_original: Is looking at sunflowers...a good thing?
records.en: Is looking at sunflowers...a good thing?

records.jp: んー。そうじゃなくて
records.en_original: Hmm, that's not what I meant.
records.en: Hmm, that's not what I meant.

records.jp: 詩さんと一緒にのんびりできること、かな
records.en_original: I meant that it's nice to be able to relax with you, Uta.
records.en: I meant that it's nice to be able to relax with you, Uta-san.

records.jp: 私とのんびり……。<CR>星崎さんは、そんなことが楽しいんですか？
records.en_original: Relax with me... Is that enjoyable for you, Ao?
records.en: Relax with me...<CR>Is that enjoyable for you, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: もちろんだよ。こうしてふたりでのんびり。<CR>めっちゃいいなーって
records.en_original: Of course I do! Just the two of us chilling together like this... It's the best!
records.en: Of course I do! Just the two of us chilling together like this...<CR>It's the best!

records.jp: 詩さんと、こんな風にどうでもいい話とか<CR>だらだらできるし、最高だよ
records.en_original: It's great just being here with you and talking about whatever we want, Uta.
records.en: It's great just being here with you and talking about whatever we want,<CR>Uta-san.

records.jp: ……最高かは分かりませんが、<CR>星崎さんの手が暖かいです
records.en_original: I don't know if it's the best...but your hand is warm, Ao.
records.en: I don't know if it's the best...but your hand is warm,<CR>Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: えへ。詩さんの手も、あったかいよ
records.en_original: Eheh. Your hand is warm too, Uta.
records.en: Eheh. Your hand is warm too, Uta-san.

records.jp: そうだなー。詩さんと一緒の思い出が、<CR>また一個増えるでしょ？　嬉しくない？
records.en_original: I meant... It's nice to make new memories together. Doesn't that make you happy?
records.en: Let's see. It gives us another memory together, Uta-san.<CR>Doesn't that make you happy?

records.jp: 私との思い出が増えると、<CR>星崎さんは嬉しい……ですか？
records.en_original: Does making new memories together make you happy, Ao?
records.en: Does making new memories together make you happy,<CR>Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: うん。友達との大事なメモリー的な？
records.en_original: Yeah. This'll become an important memory with an important friend.
records.en: Yeah. This'll become an important memory with an important friend.

records.jp: いろんな思い出作ってさ、後で<CR>あの時こんなことしたよねーって話せるし
records.en_original: We can make lots of memories and then reminisce about them later.
records.en: We can make lots of memories<CR>and then reminisce about them later.

records.jp: ……今日、私は星崎さんとひまわりを見て、<CR>夏について話をした……こんな風にですか？
records.en_original: Today I looked at sunflowers with Ao. We talked about summer... Like that?
records.en: Today I looked at sunflowers with Hoshizaki-san.<CR>We talked about summer... Like that?

records.jp: そうそう。そんな風に……ひゃっ！？
records.en_original: Yeah! Just like tha—whaaa?!
records.en: Yeah! Just like tha—whaaa?!

records.jp: そして、私が手をつないでみたら、<CR>星崎さんの反応が面白かった……ですね
records.en_original: And then I held Ao's hand, and her reaction was very funny...
records.en: And then I held Hoshizaki-san's hand,<CR>and her reaction was very funny...

records.jp: そ、そんなに面白かったかなぁ
records.en_original: W-was it really that funny?
records.en: W-was it really that funny?

records.jp: ……そうですね。<CR>星崎さんとの思い出、いいかもしれませんね
records.en_original: Yes... I think my memories with you will be good ones.
records.en: ...Yes.<CR>Memories with you might be nice, Hoshizaki-san.

records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
